  "/Users/dijkstra/ACSL-Agent 2/acsl模块化验证/.venv/bin/python" -m engine.harness_spectool inject --src <stub.c> --out <main.acsl.c> --loops '<JSON>'
- Verify:
  "/Users/dijkstra/ACSL-Agent 2/acsl模块化验证/.venv/bin/python" -m engine.harness_spectool verify -f <main.acsl.c> --timeout 8 --save-stdout <main.wp.txt>
- locate-fail: ... --wp <main.wp.txt> --src <main.acsl.c>
- check-admit: ... check-admit -f <main.acsl.c>

HARD CONSTRAINTS:
1. Only ADD ACSL annotations (loop invariant/loop assigns/loop variant/function contract). Keep every original C token and every original //@ assert(...) byte-for-byte unchanged in main.acsl.c.
2. NEVER use admit, assume, axiom, or any unproved fallback contract. The platform proof policy forbids all admits.
3. The 'unknown()' call is an extern function with no contract; that is fine — WP treats it as returning an arbitrary int.
4. The goal assertion is: `//@ assert(sn == -1);` inside `if(sn != x)`. To prove it: x and sn both start at 0 and both increment by 1 each loop iteration, so they remain equal. Provide a loop invariant `x == sn` (and bounds if needed) on the while loop, so that after the loop x==sn, hence sn!=x is false and the branch (and its assert) is never reached.

PROCEDURE:
1. Read both input files, understand the loop.
2. Determine the exact line of the `while (unknown())` keyword in the stub file.
3. Build a loops JSON with one entry line=<that line>, acsl="loop invariant 0 <= x && x <= ... ; loop invariant x == sn; loop assigns x, sn; loop variant ...;". Note: the while condition uses unknown(), WiP may not be able to prove termination/variant easily; if loop variant fails, you may omit the loop variant (or use a variant that works) — but verify each time. The loop could run infinitely (unknown() may always be true), so a loop variant proving termination may be impossible; in that case omit the loop variant and loop assigns may be needed. Iterate to get a Pass or the best possible result.
4. Inject, verify, locate-fail, fix. Up to 5 rounds.
5. check-admit must report ok:true (no illegal admits).
6. Confirm original assert and all tokens preserved.

When finished, return a JSON object (as your final message) with:
{"file":"main.c","status":"pass"|"fail","proved":N,"total":M,"loops_added":K,"notes":"..."}
